feature_name: Include Common Chunks in ESLint Plugin Package
description: Ensure the `oxlint-plugin-eslint` npm package includes all necessary common chunks in its published files. Currently, the package.json's `files` field is missing these chunks, which would cause the published package to be broken or incomplete. Update the build configuration to properly include these common chunks.
functional_requirements: Update the package.json's `files` field to include all common chunk files required for the package to function correctly
Modify the TypeScript build configuration to ensure common chunks are generated and included in the final package
Verify that the published package contains all necessary files and dependencies after the changes
